name: Honeypot Hall whole-building visual mesh
accuracy: Approximate visual proportions; not dimensionally accurate survey geometry

format.geometry: OBJ with polygon faces, not edge-only line records
format.materials: Companion MTL linked by mtllib/usemtl; simple material colours to avoid missing texture dependencies
format.wireframe: Displayed by receiving software; retain meaningful architectural edges and avoid individual brick geometry

existing_sources.coverage: Glazed stair enclosure and portions of adjacent facades; photos visually available but original files not local

existing_sources.note: Use measured brickwork where relevant; cap remains estimated

footprint_reference.coordinate_status: GA graphic outline; not survey model coordinates

ga_written_levels_m.source: Visible written level labels on existing GA elevation, p7
ga_written_levels_m.interpretation: Cross-check level associations against additional photographs; do not assume 10.8 is a flat roof plane

requested_additional_evidence: Corner views tying adjacent facades together
Roof-level structures and changes of height
approximation_policy: Engineer expressly permits approximate whole-building visual reconstruction. Keep estimated proportions separate from measured roof-support and bespoke-item model records; do not reuse this mesh as dimensioned engineering evidence.

included: simplified visible telecom equipment and rails

additional_photos.description: Exterior wing and corner with rooftop frame, trees/car in foreground
Courtyard, glazed stair and long facade with mixed window groups, chimney/rooftop room
Rear corner, roof guardrails, freestanding antennas and windows; neighbouring pitched house excluded
Overhead chimney and roof view showing cap centre slab, rooflights and roof arrangement
Close rooftop room photo: open access door beside chimney, large white horizontal cladding panel, pitched felt roof and pale fascia; freestanding frames beyond

modelling_decisions.roof_equipment: Engineer authorises basic renderings, not detailed connections
modelling_decisions.material_assets: Flat colour MTL, no external bitmap textures required
modelling_decisions.mesh_style: Architectural surface polygons; no individual-brick mesh
modelling_decisions.dimensions: Approximate visual reconstruction expressly authorised; preserve separate accurate survey records

approximate_features: Unseen windows represented with repeated representative openings
Equipment positions and rooftop room proportions approximate
No individual brickwork or hidden construction

orientation_correction.cause: Source drawing Y-down coordinates were extruded directly into a right-handed 3D scene; prior top-view inversion masked the reflection
orientation_correction.fix: Reflect source plan Y into world -Y before export; reverse surface winding; render from corrected mesh
orientation_correction.verification: Signed orientation of frame A, frame B and chimney agrees with north-up GA

features: chimney-side opening and outward-open door leaf
white panel and horizontal cladding joints on frame-facing gable
roof overhang, eaves and gable fascia
rooftop_refinement.dimensions: Unmeasured visual estimates; does not amend measured roof-support or chimney drawings
